title: ui.option 1.0
description: ui::Option (experimental): one option of the game's options_system and the restriction tags that say where it shows. Layers add tags to a stock option.

restriction_tags.description: Where it shows: the option's tags, one list over the kinds of options_system.context (gamesetup_f1, PreSession, Unranked, ...). The stock record game/<option> holds the game's own list; a layer's additions and removals are written into the option's tag rows at boot.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.
